data.title: AI Document Template Cluster — Identical Formatting Patterns Across Applications
data.description: Detects clusters of submitted ID documents sharing identical formatting artifacts, template structures, or AI generation signatures. AI document generators produce documents with consistent pixel-level artifacts, font embedding patterns, and template metadata even when the identity details differ. When 3+ documents from different applicants show template_similarity_score > 0.85, this indicates a common AI generator. Underground forgery services like OnlyFake successors use a limited number of document templates per jurisdiction, creating detectable clustering when multiple synthetic identities are onboarded through the same forgery pipeline. Template similarity analysis across the document corpus reveals these clusters even when individual documents pass automated verification checks.

detection.condition: selection_document_submission AND template_similarity_score > 0.85 across 3+ documents from different applicant_name/ssn_hash combinations within 90 days

enrichment_required.source: Document analysis — pairwise similarity score (0-1) comparing document template structure
Document clustering model — cluster assignment based on template structural features
Image analysis — perceptual hash of pixel-level artifacts in document background
Font analysis — hash of font embedding characteristics across document text regions
Threat intel — match against known forgery service template database

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for AI Document Template Cluster Detection
// Detects clusters of documents sharing AI generation template signatures
event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
| submission_timestamp > now() - 90d
| groupBy(template_cluster_id, function=[
    count(as=cluster_size),
    count(distinct=true, field=applicant_name, as=distinct_applicants),
    count(distinct=true, field=ssn_hash, as=distinct_ssns),
    avg(template_similarity_score, as=avg_similarity),
    collect([applicant_id, applicant_name, submission_timestamp,
             document_type, device_fingerprint], limit=50) as cluster_members,
    min(submission_timestamp) as cluster_start,
    max(submission_timestamp) as cluster_end
  ])
| cluster_size >= 3 AND distinct_applicants >= 3 AND avg_similarity > 0.85
| select([template_cluster_id, cluster_size, distinct_applicants,
          distinct_ssns, avg_similarity, cluster_start, cluster_end,
          cluster_members])
| sort(cluster_size, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI Document Template Cluster Detection")`
`comment("Detects clusters of documents sharing AI generation template signatures")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
  earliest=-90d@d
| stats
    count as cluster_size,
    dc(applicant_name) as distinct_applicants,
    dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
    avg(template_similarity_score) as avg_similarity,
    values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
    values(applicant_name) as names,
    values(document_type) as document_types,
    min(submission_timestamp) as cluster_start,
    max(submission_timestamp) as cluster_end
    by template_cluster_id
| where cluster_size >= 3 AND distinct_applicants >= 3 AND avg_similarity > 0.85
| eval cluster_time_span_days = round((cluster_end - cluster_start) / 86400, 1)
| table template_cluster_id, cluster_size, distinct_applicants,
        distinct_ssns, avg_similarity, cluster_start, cluster_end,
        cluster_time_span_days, applicant_ids, names, document_types
| sort - cluster_size
queries.sql:
-- SQL for AI Document Template Cluster Detection
-- Detects clusters of documents sharing AI generation template signatures
SELECT
  d.template_cluster_id,
  COUNT(*) AS cluster_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.applicant_name) AS distinct_applicants,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ssn_hash) AS distinct_ssns,
  AVG(d.template_similarity_score) AS avg_similarity,
  MIN(d.submission_timestamp) AS cluster_start,
  MAX(d.submission_timestamp) AS cluster_end,
  DATEDIFF(DAY, MIN(d.submission_timestamp), MAX(d.submission_timestamp)) AS cluster_time_span_days,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d.applicant_name, ', ') AS names,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT d.applicant_id, ', ') AS applicant_ids
FROM document_submissions d
WHERE d.event_type = 'DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION'
  AND d.submission_timestamp >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND d.template_cluster_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.template_cluster_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.applicant_name) >= 3
  AND AVG(d.template_similarity_score) > 0.85
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

references: Entrust 2025 Identity Fraud Report — document template clustering analysis
Trend Micro, Underground KYC Bypass Market Research — forgery service template reuse
LexisNexis Risk Solutions, Global State of Fraud and Identity Report 2026
falsepositives: Legitimate documents from the same jurisdiction and issuance period sharing standard government templates
Documents scanned by the same institutional scanner producing consistent compression artifacts
Batch submissions from legitimate corporate onboarding processes
